arxiv-2411-08862.creator: Piyush Jha, Arnav Arora, Vijay Ganesh
arxiv-2411-08862.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Piyush Jha, Arnav Arora, Vijay Ganesh. We introduce LLM Stinger , a novel approach that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to automatically generate adversarial suffixes for jailbreak attacks. Unlike traditional methods, which require complex prompt engineering or white-box access, LLM Stinger uses a reinforcement learning (RL) loop to fine-tune an attacker LLM, generating new suffixes based on existing attacks for harmful questions from the HarmBench benchmark.

arxiv-2510-20266.title: GUSL-Dehaze: A Green U-Shaped Learning Approach to Image Dehazing
arxiv-2510-20266.creator: Mahtab Movaheddrad, Laurence Palmer, C.-C. Jay Kuo
arxiv-2510-20266.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Mahtab Movaheddrad, Laurence Palmer, C.-C. Jay Kuo. Image dehazing is a restoration task that aims to recover a clear image from a single hazy input. Traditional approaches rely on statistical priors and the physics-based atmospheric scattering model to reconstruct the haze-free image. While recent state-of-the-art methods are predominantly based on deep learning architectures, these models often involve high computational costs and large parameter sizes, making them unsuitable for resource-constrained devices. In this work, we propose GUSL-Dehaze, a Green U-Shaped Learning approach to image dehazing.

pmc-13164376.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background: Respiratory viral infections remain a major cause of morbidity and hospitalization in children. The increased use of multiplex molecular assays has improved the detection of simultaneous viral pathogens, raising questions about the clinical relevance of pediatric viral co-infections. Objective: The aim of this study is to synthesize recent evidence on respiratory viral co-infections in children, focusing on clinical severity, healthcare burden, mechanisms, and interpretation of multiplex detections.
